'''2003 Chandrila State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Italy (June 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Italy
* '''Dates:''' June 2003
